title: End-to-End Optical Semantic Communication over a Nonlinear WDM Fiber Link
abstract: arXiv:2609.37551v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Emerging optical-network applications increasingly use received data for inference and control rather than exact source reproduction, creating an opportunity to trade bit-level fidelity for greater transmission reach and efficiency. We propose an end-to-end optical semantic communication system for joint image classification and reconstruction over a nonlinear wavelength-division multiplexed (WDM) fiber channel. The system maps each image directly into a fixed-length sequence of channel symbols that preserves task-relevant information, without explicit source compression or channel coding. Experiments on the MNIST dataset cover launch powers from -9 to +3 dBm, fiber lengths up to 800 km, and 16-, 64-, and 256-Quadrature Amplitude Modulation (QAM) formats. At 0 dBm, classification accuracy remains between 98.92% and 99.31% across all tested link lengths and modulation orders, while requiring fewer transmitted symbols than a Low-Density

translated_title: 非线性波分复用光纤链路上的端到端光语义通信
translated_abstract: 新兴的光网络应用越来越多地将接收到的数据用于推理和控制，而非精确的源重建，这为以比特级保真度换取更大的传输距离和效率创造了机会。我们提出了一种端到端的光语义通信系统，用于在非线性波分复用（WDM）光纤信道上进行图像分类与重建的联合任务。该系统将每张图像直接映射为保留任务相关信息的固定长度信道符号序列，无需显式的信源压缩或信道编码。在MNIST数据集上的实验涵盖了-9到+3 dBm的发射功率、长达800 km的光纤长度，以及16、64和256阶正交幅度调制（QAM）格式。在0 dBm发射功率下，在所有测试的链路长度和调制阶数下，分类准确率保持在98.92%至99.31%之间，同时所需传输的符号数少于低密度
tldr: 提出了一种在非线性WDM光纤链路上联合实现图像分类与重建的端到端光语义通信系统，无需信源压缩或信道编码，在长达800 km的传输距离和多种调制格式下仍能保持98%以上的分类准确率。
en_tdlr: An end-to-end optical semantic communication system is proposed for joint image classification and reconstruction over nonlinear WDM fiber links, which directly maps images into channel symbol sequences without explicit source compression or channel coding, maintaining over 98% classification accuracy across distances up to 800 km and various QAM formats.
